items.title: Gyro Balancer Test Station
items.description: Modernization of a legacy electrical test station used for gyro balancing operations. Engineering work included legacy-system reconstruction, requirements and interface definition, electrical design, component selection, integration, troubleshooting, and verification and validation.

items.title: Drift Test Station
items.description: Modernization of a legacy electrical test station supporting drift testing. Engineering work included evaluation of the legacy design, requirements development, electrical redesign, commercial component integration, design documentation, multidisciplinary coordination, and verification and validation.

items.title: Impedance Test Station
items.description: Modernization of a legacy impedance test station, including reconstruction and analysis of legacy circuitry, electrical redesign, integration, troubleshooting, and verification and validation. Work included development and troubleshooting of signal-conditioning circuitry as a subassembly of the overall test-station design.

items.title: Utility Mapping & Inventory System Consolidation
items.description: Engineering documentation project involving mapping of underground and surface utilities, translation of field information into CAD drawings, and consolidation of equipment and drawing records into a searchable information system.

items.title: Robotics Course & Laboratory Overhaul
items.description: Modernization of robotics curriculum and laboratory resources through needs assessment, benchmarking, curriculum development, equipment evaluation and selection, laboratory planning, safety considerations, and implementation.

items.title: Engineering Technology Course Hybridization & Virtualization
items.description: Restructuring of engineering technology coursework and laboratory activities for hybrid and virtual delivery while maintaining technical learning objectives and practical engineering content.

items.title: Engineering Technology Capstone Design Program
items.description: Development and support of engineering technology capstone design activities, including project planning, technical mentoring, design review, documentation, fabrication, testing, and evaluation of student engineering projects.

items.title: Industrial Internet of Things Monitoring System
items.description: Development of wireless embedded sensor nodes for industrial equipment monitoring and troubleshooting. The system incorporated temperature, humidity, and vibration sensing, custom electronics, embedded software, LoRa wireless communication, calibration, and communication-reliability testing. The work contributed to an IEEE IECON 2018 publication.

items.title: Advanced Energy Vehicle
items.description: Multidisciplinary engineering project involving development and testing of an autonomous electric vehicle with emphasis on energy efficiency, system integration, iterative testing, and engineering design.

items.title: RV-2SQ Robotic Welding Attachment
items.description: Engineering project involving the design and development of a robotic welding attachment for a Mitsubishi RV-2SQ industrial robot.

items.title: GPS/INS Navigation Engineering
items.description: Graduate engineering work involving satellite, inertial, and integrated navigation systems, including analysis and implementation of navigation concepts developed through graduate electrical engineering study.

items.title: C++ Sensor Processing & Continuous Integration
items.description: Personal software engineering project focused on a C++ sensor-processing application and a disciplined continuous-integration workflow. Placeholder for documentation of architecture, automated builds, unit testing, CI/CD, merge-request validation, artifacts, and failure-recovery testing.

items.title: Trading Card Cataloging & Recognition System
items.description: Personal computer-vision and software-engineering project for automating the identification, classification, and cataloging of trading cards from images. Placeholder for the evolving recognition pipeline, dataset strategy, validation workflow, and application architecture.

items.title: Custom Aquarium Stand & Sump System
items.description: Personal engineering and fabrication project for a furniture-style aquarium stand and integrated sump system. Placeholder for structural design, CAD modeling, plumbing, water containment, serviceability, fabrication, and system-integration documentation.

items.title: The Modular Circuit Handbook
items.description: Long-form engineering reference project developing a practical circuit atlas for engineers and technical practitioners, supported by a structured library of reusable circuit schematics and engineering explanations.

items.title: Engineering Reference Website
items.description: Development of a data-driven static engineering portfolio and knowledge base using Eleventy, structured canonical content, relationship validation, reusable layouts, and deterministic import tooling.
